reading: Social media is significantly altering the concert experience, with "big moments from headline acts" often shared online long before many fans attend the actual shows.
Months before you have a chance to see your favourite artist, chances are you already know some of the big moments they have planned.
You'll also probably know the set list, the stage design, and - if you've really been paying attention - where to stand to get the best view.
For many major gigs, there's no escaping a stream of fan videos if you're online, whether you like it or not.
For instance, surprises from Olivia Rodrigo's Unraveled tour, which scores of fans paid a lot for, have already been "dissected online".
While some fans "lap up" the opportunity to see what's coming, others are taking "extreme measures" to preserve the element of surprise.
Aurélia Collins, a dedicated fan, spends weeks trying to "trick her algorithm" into not serving her content about favourite artists.
She finds this effort "worth it for the surprise," even if it means her social media feed is a bit bland.
Collins was "gutted" when a spoiler about Niall Horan slipped through, just before her first live show after 16 years of fandom.
She explains that because she couldn't afford live music when younger, she now really wants to "take it in" such a moment.
She wants the "full experience," emphasizing the element of surprise that people attending the opening night can get.
Not all fans view spoilers negatively; Georgia McAdam claims she loves them.
McAdam sees online spoilers more as "teasers" and believes no amount of videos can diminish the excitement of the real thing.
She acknowledges that sometimes artists offer different "surprise songs" or unexpected actions at shows.
Some artists react by "switching up" their sets in small ways each night to ensure fans coming to later dates still see something unexpected.
For example, Taylor Swift featured "bespoke outfits" and surprise songs, while Sabrina Carpenter and Jay-Z also varied their shows.
Laura Snapes, deputy music editor for The Guardian, notes that artists can ensure "they're staying in the press" by having something different happen nightly.
Snapes adds that if fans want to be surprised, they "have to protect yourself from absorbing any of that culture" by avoiding online content.
Phoebe Bridgers is taking things further by banning phones altogether at her shows.
Attendees must lock their phones and recording devices in a special pouch when they enter the venue to see the US singer.
Anyone found breaking the rules will be escorted out.
McAdam would not support a ban on phones, arguing that recording at gigs is "part of the experience" for many fans.
Conversely, Collins states she is "not totally against it" regarding phone bans.
What Collins would prefer is to see more spoiler warnings on videos to give fans the option for surprise.
Ultimately, Snapes suggests that even with set list knowledge, fans may still witness "moments of humanity and stuff that's unplanned."
She cites Taylor Swift blowing her nose during the Edinburgh Eras show as an example of an unscripted moment.

vocabulary.definition: The most important or famous performers at a concert or festival.
Analyzed or examined in detail, often critically, by a large audience online.
To eagerly accept or enjoy something, especially information or attention, with enthusiasm.
Difficult or severe actions taken to achieve a particular aim, often because normal methods are insufficient.
To manipulate the personalized content delivery system of a social media platform to avoid specific types of content.
Extremely disappointed or upset; feeling a deep sense of loss or frustration (informal).
To fully comprehend, absorb, or appreciate something, often an experience or a view.
Clothing that is custom-made to a client's specifications or for a particular occasion.
To change or vary something, often to introduce new elements or to keep it interesting.
To be formally led away from a place, typically by security personnel, often due to a violation of rules.

entries.ja: コンサートやフェスティバルで最も重要または有名な出演者。
entries.ko: 콘서트나 축제에서 가장 중요하거나 유명한 출연자.
entries.zh-Hans: 音乐会或音乐节上最重要或最著名的表演者。
entries.es: Los artistas más importantes o famosos en un concierto o festival.
entries.pt-BR: Os artistas mais importantes ou famosos em um concerto ou festival.
entries.fr: Les artistes les plus importants ou les plus célèbres lors d'un concert ou d'un festival.
entries.de: Die wichtigsten oder berühmtesten Künstler bei einem Konzert oder Festival.

entries.ja: オンライン上で多くの視聴者によって、しばしば批判的に、詳細に分析または検討された。
entries.ko: 온라인상에서 많은 관객에 의해 종종 비판적으로 상세하게 분석되거나 검토된.
entries.zh-Hans: 在网上被广大受众详细分析或审视，通常带有批判性。
entries.es: Analizado o examinado en detalle, a menudo de forma crítica, por una gran audiencia en línea.
entries.pt-BR: Analisado ou examinado em detalhes, muitas vezes criticamente, por um grande público online.
entries.fr: Analysé ou examiné en détail, souvent de manière critique, par un large public en ligne.
entries.de: Von einem großen Online-Publikum detailliert, oft kritisch, analysiert oder untersucht.

entries.ja: 何かを、特に情報や注目を、熱意を持って受け入れたり楽しんだりすること。
entries.ko: 무언가, 특히 정보나 관심을 열정적으로 기쁘게 받아들이거나 즐기는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 欣然接受或享受某事，特别是信息或关注，充满热情。
entries.es: Aceptar o disfrutar algo con entusiasmo, especialmente información o atención, con avidez.
entries.pt-BR: Aceitar ou desfrutar algo com entusiasmo, especialmente informações ou atenção, de forma ávida.
entries.fr: Accepter ou apprécier avec avidité et enthousiasme quelque chose, en particulier une information ou une attention.
entries.de: Etwas, insbesondere Informationen oder Aufmerksamkeit, mit Begeisterung und Eifer aufnehmen oder genießen.

entries.ja: 特定の目的を達成するために取られる困難な、または厳しい行動。通常の手段では不十分な場合によく用いられる。
entries.ko: 특정한 목표를 달성하기 위해 취하는 어렵거나 강경한 조치로, 보통 일반적인 방법으로는 충분하지 않을 때 사용됩니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 为实现特定目标而采取的艰难或严厉的行动，通常是因为常规方法不足以解决问题。
entries.es: Acciones difíciles o severas tomadas para lograr un objetivo particular, a menudo porque los métodos normales son insuficientes.
entries.pt-BR: Ações difíceis ou severas tomadas para alcançar um objetivo específico, muitas vezes porque os métodos normais são insuficientes.
entries.fr: Des actions difficiles ou sévères entreprises pour atteindre un objectif particulier, souvent parce que les méthodes normales sont insuffisantes.
entries.de: Schwierige oder drastische Maßnahmen, die ergriffen werden, um ein bestimmtes Ziel zu erreichen, oft weil normale Methoden nicht ausreichen.

entries.ja: ソーシャルメディアプラットフォームのパーソナライズされたコンテンツ配信システムを操作して、特定の種類のコンテンツが表示されないようにすること。
entries.ko: 소셜 미디어 플랫폼의 개인화된 콘텐츠 전달 시스템을 조작하여 특정 유형의 콘텐츠를 피하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 操纵社交媒体平台的个性化内容推送系统，以避免接收特定类型的内容。
entries.es: Manipular el sistema de entrega de contenido personalizado de una plataforma de redes sociales para evitar tipos específicos de contenido.
entries.pt-BR: Manipular o sistema de entrega de conteúdo personalizado de uma plataforma de mídia social para evitar tipos específicos de conteúdo.
entries.fr: Manipuler le système de diffusion de contenu personnalisé d'une plateforme de médias sociaux pour éviter certains types de contenu.
entries.de: Das personalisierte Inhaltslieferungssystem einer sozialen Medienplattform so manipulieren, dass bestimmte Arten von Inhalten vermieden werden.

entries.ja: 非常にがっかりしている、またはひどく動揺していること。深い喪失感や欲求不満を感じていること（インフォーマル）。
entries.ko: 극도로 실망하거나 화가 난 상태. 깊은 상실감이나 좌절감을 느끼는 것 (비격식).
entries.zh-Hans: 极其失望或沮丧；感到深深的失落或挫败感（非正式）。
entries.es: Extremadamente decepcionado o molesto; sentir una profunda sensación de pérdida o frustración (informal).
entries.pt-BR: Extremamente desapontado ou chateado; sentir uma profunda sensação de perda ou frustração (informal).
entries.fr: Extrêmement déçu ou bouleversé ; ressentir un profond sentiment de perte ou de frustration (informel).
entries.de: Extrem enttäuscht oder verärgert; ein tiefes Gefühl von Verlust oder Frustration empfindend (informell).

entries.ja: 何か、多くの場合経験や景色を、完全に理解し、吸収し、または評価すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것, 종종 경험이나 풍경을 완전히 이해하고 흡수하며 감상하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 完全理解、吸收或欣赏某事，通常指一种体验或景色。
entries.es: Comprender, asimilar o apreciar completamente algo, a menudo una experiencia o una vista.
entries.pt-BR: Compreender, absorver ou apreciar algo completamente, muitas vezes uma experiência ou uma vista.
entries.fr: Comprendre, assimiler ou apprécier pleinement quelque chose, souvent une expérience ou un paysage.
entries.de: Etwas, oft ein Erlebnis oder eine Ansicht, vollständig begreifen, aufnehmen oder würdigen.

entries.ja: 顧客の仕様または特定の機会に合わせてオーダーメイドされた衣料品。
entries.ko: 고객의 사양이나 특정 행사에 맞춰 맞춤 제작된 의류.
entries.zh-Hans: 根据客户的具体要求或为特定场合定制的服装。
entries.es: Ropa hecha a medida según las especificaciones de un cliente o para una ocasión particular.
entries.pt-BR: Roupas feitas sob medida de acordo com as especificações de um cliente ou para uma ocasião específica.
entries.fr: Des vêtements faits sur mesure selon les spécifications d'un client ou pour une occasion particulière.
entries.de: Kleidung, die nach den Spezifikationen eines Kunden oder für einen bestimmten Anlass maßgeschneidert wurde.

entries.ja: 何かを変えたり、多様にしたりすること。しばしば新しい要素を導入したり、興味を保つために行われる。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 바꾸거나 다양하게 하는 것. 종종 새로운 요소를 도입하거나 흥미를 유지하기 위해 이루어집니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 改变或变换某事，通常是为了引入新元素或保持其趣味性。
entries.es: Cambiar o variar algo, a menudo para introducir nuevos elementos o para mantenerlo interesante.
entries.pt-BR: Mudar ou variar algo, muitas vezes para introduzir novos elementos ou para mantê-lo interessante.
entries.fr: Changer ou varier quelque chose, souvent pour introduire de nouveaux éléments ou pour maintenir l'intérêt.
entries.de: Etwas ändern oder variieren, oft um neue Elemente einzuführen oder es interessant zu halten.

entries.ja: 多くの場合、規則違反のために、警備員などによって場所から正式に連れ出されること。
entries.ko: 일반적으로 규칙 위반으로 인해 보안 요원 등에 의해 공식적으로 특정 장소에서 안내되어 나가는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 被正式地带离某个地方，通常由安保人员执行，往往是因为违反了规定。
entries.es: Ser formalmente guiado fuera de un lugar, típicamente por personal de seguridad, a menudo debido a una violación de las reglas.
entries.pt-BR: Ser formalmente levado para fora de um local, geralmente por seguranças, muitas vezes devido a uma violação das regras.
entries.fr: Être formellement conduit hors d'un lieu, généralement par le personnel de sécurité, souvent en raison d'une violation des règles.
entries.de: Von einem Ort formell weggeführt werden, typischerweise von Sicherheitspersonal, oft aufgrund einer Regelverletzung.
